title: citrus × racemosa
intro: Citrus × racemosa, commonly known as Mandarin or Satsuma, is a hybrid citrus plant that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and acting as an antioxidant, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Citrus × racemosa include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve mood, and aid in sleep regulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its various health benefits.
